requirements.statement: Every place that commits run records today writes the feature's records ref via record-ref.js write instead: implement-trd phase checkpoint, audit-build (report, round ledger, close record, artifact link), close-feature, ship-build Step 5 and each ship step, verify-build result, every store/record link commit after an artifact publish, plan (incl. sweep chain commit), amend, refine-verification, task close. Must pass.

Worktree copy of run records is git-ignored: gitignore-framework.txt ignores .trd-state/ except .trd-state/_docs-audit/, delivered by ensure_gitignore; .claude/verification-notes.md and OWNER-CALLS.md stay tracked. Must pass.
implement-trd phase checkpoint commits product code only (still git add -A) and the checkpoint it records names that code commit. Must pass.
One write before every COMMAND COMPLETE and COMMAND STUCK banner of a command that touched records, stated once in .claude/rules/command-status.md; no write per file save.
The ship push step pushes the feature's records ref beside its branch. Must pass per TRD table? (not marked)
/sweep and precompact.js write the shared ref refs/ensemble/records/_shared.
Scaffold stamps ensemble.records: "ref" in .claude/settings.json, backfilled with setdefault like ensemble.publishArtifacts.

Fixture run (environment fixtures) of /plan --implement on a small change leaves no commit on the feature branch that touches only .trd-state/, and git cat-file -p refs/ensemble/records/<slug>:implement.json shows the finished task list. Must pass.

Run records are never committed on the default branch, and a write made there never replaces a feature's ref with one naming the default branch; when a write cannot reach the ref there, records stay in the worktree. Must pass.
A command restores a feature's folder from its ref before it first writes into .trd-state/<feature>/, so a fresh worktree never creates a folder that hides the ref.

Every change mirrored into packages/full and .claude/; docs/reference/ and CHANGELOG.md describe it; custody record-file ignoring and merge record-clash resolution unchanged; a prose test per touched command names record-ref.js write and finds no remaining git add/commit of a .trd-state/ path; bats scaffold-project.test.sh covers ignore lines and settings key; full battery green.

A write that moves branch-tracked records onto the ref also commits their removal from the branch (feature branches only, never shared logs), so the removal does not block the ship merge step; hooks and the ship loop never make a branch commit. Must pass.
record-ref.js write never replaces a ref's post-merge shipped.json or custody.json with an older worktree copy when the ref's ship record is further along. Must pass.

grep for git add/commit of .trd-state/ paths in packages/core/commands and contracts finds nothing; plan.md 7a.5 commit list names no .trd-state/ path; the ten listed commands name record-ref.js write (plus ship-primitive-push.md); a Jest prose test pins both.

In a scaffolded repo, git check-ignore --no-index reports the record paths as ignored and does not report _docs-audit/last-run.json, .claude/verification-notes.md or OWNER-CALLS.md; --git-files and scaffold leave tracked records tracked; scratch lines still untrack; settings has ensemble.records == "ref" and owner value survives --refresh.

implement-trd Step 5 runs git add -A; git commit first, records the checkpoint with that commit id, then record-ref.js write; in a fixture run the checkpoint commit equals the code commit and the branch has no records-only commit.

record-ref.js write on the default branch or detached HEAD never creates a branch commit and never untracks; failed push returns outcome ref, push failed; unwritable ref returns outcome failed with fallbackSkipped default-branch; identity mismatch on default branch returns refused; --no-fallback gives no-commit rule on any branch; --shared never untracks; feature-branch fold commits its removal by pathspec.
precompact.js with no feature writes refs/ensemble/records/_shared locally (no push, no network) after appending to _session-log.md; /sweep writes the shared ref at its end.

With post-merge shipped.json and custody.json on the ref and older copies in the worktree folder, record-ref.js write leaves the ref holding the post-merge copies while other folder records update; when the worktree copy is further along it is written as before.

tasks.description: record-ref.js write: default-branch / detached-HEAD no-fallback, no-fold, identity refusal; --no-fallback on any branch; --shared never folds; feature-branch fold commits its removal by pathspec. Serves O9, O12. Acceptance: Jest cases listed in TRD Master Task List. Dependencies: none.

Ignore lines (# @ignore-only marker, .trd-state/*, !.trd-state/_docs-audit/), ensure_gitignore skips untrack after marker, stamp backfills ensemble.records via setdefault, settings template and this repo's settings/gitignore updated; BATS cases updated. Serves O2, O7. Dependencies: none.

command-status.md gains a Run records go to the records ref section (ensure, one write before each banner, --shared, never git add/commit .trd-state, outcome reporting); Artifact links paragraph updated. Serves O4, O10. Dependencies: none.
implement-trd Step 5 reorder: commit code, record checkpoint with COMMIT_SHA, then record-ref.js write; final write before banners; reference doc updated. Serves O1, O3, O4. Dependencies: FIX-003.

audit-build and close-feature: ensure at start; TRD-only commit plus write replacing report/close and artifact-link commits; PR gates on close not write outcome; default-branch NEXT lines updated. Serves O1, O9, O10. Dependencies: FIX-003.

ship-build: per-step --no-fallback writes until merge, Step 5 ordinary write, remoteResume park push becomes the write; ship-primitive-push writes ref before pushing branch and excludes .trd-state from sweep; resume workflow template comment updated. Serves O1, O5, O12. Dependencies: FIX-001, FIX-003.

verify-build, refine-verification, amend, task, plan: one write before each banner (and before chained RETURN lines); task close writes its ref; plan 7a.5 drops the sweep folder from the commit list and writes it to its ref. Serves O1, O4. Dependencies: FIX-003.

sweep writes --shared at its end; precompact.js writes shared ref with push false and fallback false after appending session log, swallowing failures; Jest case; mirror to .claude; hooks reference row. Serves O6, O12. Dependencies: FIX-001, FIX-003.

Prose test records-ref-writers-prose.test.js: no git add/commit of .trd-state paths in commands and contracts; each touched command names record-ref.js write; command-status rule present; touched command files equal their .claude copies. Serves O1, O4, O11. Dependencies: FIX-003 through FIX-008.

CHANGELOG Unreleased entry; reference docs rows (README, other-commands); init-project and rebase-project prose that contradicts the rule (source and .claude copies); full battery. Serves O11. Dependencies: FIX-001 through FIX-009.

Amendment: record-ref.js write keeps ref tip's shipped.json and custody.json when the tip ship record is further along than the worktree copy (after merging origin/main, PR #121). Serves O13. Dependencies: FIX-001.

open_questions: OQ-1 (not owner-only): "/ship-build Step 5 and each ship step" read as one --no-fallback write after each step result until the merge step has run, plus Step 5's ordinary write; a write with nothing changed still pushes. Assumed: yes.
OQ-2 (not owner-only): should a records write's fallback or failed outcome stop a command? Assumed: no; one ISSUES line, never STUCK, records stay in the worktree.
could_not_verify: Claude Code Web (claude --remote) pushing or fetching refs/ensemble/*: not reproducible from this machine (verification.md section 5). The library's branch-commit fallback covers it on a feature branch; on the default branch the records stay in the worktree.
Whether ensemble-ship-resume.yml can restore the ref on a real GitHub runner: template comment change only here; live proof still open (its header, SHIP-T002).

This feature's own records: this /plan run executes pre-change commands, so early phase checkpoints of this run may still commit .trd-state/writers-move-to-the-ref/ on the branch; the fixture run (O8) is the proof.
